description: Canonical four-way Storage Policy classification. Each policy is an authoritative value directly encoded in the .vsn container via REC_STORAGE_POLICY (0x0009) / FID_STORAGE_POLICY (0x0901). Wire-mode mapping architecture CANCELLED -- Storage Policy IS the sole normative classification on wire.

architecture_status.description: The old architecture that mapped storage policies to two wire modes (MODERN/ENTERPRISE) is CANCELLED. Storage Policy values {1,2,3,4} are direct classification on wire. No policy-to-mode mapping exists.

policies.name: HIGHLY_VERTICAL
policies.description: Maximum storage-effort optimization. Storage Policy value 1 directly encoded in container via REC_STORAGE_POLICY.
constraints: Must not claim global storage optimality

policies.name: VERTICAL
policies.description: Bounded storage-effort optimization. Storage Policy value 2 directly encoded in container.
constraints: Fallback to DIRECT-1 if no savings found

policies.name: HORIZONTAL
policies.description: Low storage-effort optimization. Storage Policy value 3 directly encoded in container.
constraints: EXTENTS-1 not forbidden at wire level but discouraged for normal writes

policies.name: HIGHLY_HORIZONTAL
policies.description: Minimal optimization effort. Storage Policy value 4 directly encoded in container.
constraints: DIRECT-1 required for ALL emitted content objects

wire_format.encoding_note: Record: u16be type + varint length + field sequence. Field: u16be fid + varint value_length + u8 value.

obsolete_architecture.mode_declaration: REC_MODE_DECLARATION (0x0007) -- OBSOLETE: deprecated, no longer emitted by canonical writers
obsolete_architecture.fid_mode: FID_MODE (0x0701) -- OBSOLETE: ModeDeclaration field ID, deprecated
obsolete_architecture.wire_modes: WireMode.MODERN (0x01) and WireMode.ENTERPRISE (0x02) -- CANCELLED: no policy-to-mode mapping exists
obsolete_architecture.policy_to_wire_mapping: CANCELLED: no storage policy value maps to a wire mode. Each policy value {1,2,3,4} is independent direct classification.
obsolete_architecture.status: Old architecture removed from normative specification
